# Capex cycle in mining

A copper mine takes ten to fifteen years from discovery to first production. Investment decisions are made on today's prices and deliver supply into a market nobody can see.

## The pattern

High prices lead to a wave of approvals. The projects arrive together, years later, into weaker demand. Prices fall below the cost of the new mines, investment is cut to the bone, and the shortage that starts the next upswing is already being built.

This is the supply half of the [[Commodity supercycle]].
